description: Defines the ExecutionFrame class which manages stateful execution data such as tensor values, weights, and memory layout for a computational graph in the torch::nativert namespace.

classes.name: ExecutionFrame
classes.description: Manages the stateful data of a graph execution, including tensor values, weights, and memory layout.

methods.name: tryMoveUserOutputs
methods.description: Attempts to move user output values out of the execution frame.

methods.name: moveIValue
methods.description: Moves and returns the IValue associated with a given ValueId.

methods.name: getIValue
methods.description: Returns a reference to the IValue associated with a given ValueId, with optional allowance for None.

methods.name: setIValue
methods.description: Sets the IValue for a specific ValueId.

methods.name: setBorrowedIValue
methods.description: Sets a borrowed IValue for a specific ValueId.

methods.name: getTensor
methods.description: Retrieves the tensor associated with a given ValueId.

methods.name: setWeights
methods.description: Sets the weights for the execution frame.
